module.title: Classical FISTA MRI reconstruction
module.expensive_path: The repeated forward FFT, masked residual, adjoint FFT, TV shrinkage, and momentum updates in the FISTA iteration loop.
module.rationale: FISTA is a conceptually independent deterministic reconstruction kernel with direct upstream unit coverage and a small synthetic input contract.
excluded: algorithms/ai: U-Net training/inference is GPU- and dataset-heavy
evaluation and visualization: downstream metrics and plotting are not part of the reconstruction kernel
algorithms/classical/admm.py: placeholder implementation without a complete official test
hazards: Numerical tolerance depends on FFT and floating-point implementation
